header: Three rules we check on every project
subheadline: When a deadline and a decision collide, these rules settle it. We read them out at every kickoff, and they have cost us two contracts.

value_items.title: Watch before you draw
value_items.description: No screen leaves the studio until one of us has watched, on site, how the work is done by hand today.

value_items.title: Accessible or unfinished
value_items.description: We check contrast, focus order and keyboard paths at every critique, not in an audit three weeks before launch.

value_items.title: Hand over everything
value_items.description: Clients keep the research recordings, the component files and the prototypes. We hold nothing back to secure a renewal.
